tasks.title: Task 1: Configure scheduled refresh for Supplier Dataflow
tasks.objective: Configure an automatic scheduled refresh for the Supplier Dataflow in the Fabric workspace.
tasks.expectedOutcome: The df_Supplier_Snowflake dataflow has a saved daily refresh schedule at 12:00 AM visible in its Schedule settings.

facts.fact: The workspace to use is FAIAD_<inject key="Deployment ID" enableCopy="false"/>.
facts.quote: FAIAD_<inject key="Deployment ID" enableCopy="false"/>

facts.fact: The artifact to configure is named df_Supplier_Snowflake.
facts.quote: df_Supplier_Snowflake

facts.fact: The learner should open the dataflow Settings option.
facts.quote: Choose the **Settings** option.

facts.fact: The schedule is configured from the Schedule option.
facts.quote: Select the **Schedule** option

facts.fact: A new schedule is activated by clicking Add Schedule.
facts.quote: click **Add Schedule**

facts.fact: The Repeat property should be set to Daily.
facts.quote: For this scenario we can choose **Daily (1)**

facts.fact: The Time property should be set to 12:00 AM.
facts.quote: For the **Time** property we can specify **12:00 AM** **(2)** since we want midnight

facts.fact: The schedule must be saved.
facts.quote: Lastly, select **Save**.

tasks.title: Task 5: Create Until Activity
tasks.objective: Add an Until activity in the pipeline to repeatedly refresh the dataflow until it succeeds or three attempts have been made.
tasks.expectedOutcome: The pipeline includes an Until activity configured to iterate the dataflow refresh until success or until three tries are reached.

facts.fact: The learner starts on the Pipeline screen.
facts.quote: You will be navigated to the Pipeline screen.

facts.fact: The Activities menu should be selected.
facts.quote: From the menu, select **Activities**.

facts.fact: The ellipsis on the right should be clicked.
facts.quote: Click the **ellipsis(…)** on the right.

facts.fact: The Until activity should be chosen from the activity list.
facts.quote: From the activity list, click **Until**.

facts.fact: The iteration is intended to continue until the condition is satisfied.
facts.quote: **Until:** is an activity that is used to iterate until a condition is satisfied.

facts.fact: In this scenario, the loop refreshes the dataflow until success or three attempts.
facts.quote: In our scenario, we are going to iterate and refresh the dataflow until it is successful, or we have tried three times.

tasks.title: Task 6: Create Variables
tasks.objective: Create five pipeline variables with the specified names, types, and default values to support iteration and status tracking.
tasks.expectedOutcome: The pipeline Variables pane contains varCounter, varTempCounter, varIsSuccess, varSuccess, and varWaitTime configured with the required types and default values.

facts.fact: A variable named varCounter is created.
facts.quote: Enter **varCounter** in the **Name text box**.

facts.fact: varCounter is of type Integer.
facts.quote: From **Type** **dropdown** select **Integer**.

facts.fact: varCounter has default value 0.
facts.quote: Enter **Default value** of **0**.

facts.fact: A variable named varTempCounter is created.
facts.quote: Enter **varTempCounter** in the **Name text box**.

facts.fact: A variable named varIsSuccess is of type String with default value No.
facts.quote: **varIsSuccess** of type **String** and default value **No**.

facts.fact: A variable named varSuccess is of type String with default value Yes.
facts.quote: **varSuccess** of type **String** and default value **Yes**.

facts.fact: A variable named varWaitTime is of type Integer with default value 60.
facts.quote: **varWaitTime** of type **Integer** and default value **60**.

tasks.title: Task 7: Configure Until Activity
tasks.objective: Configure the Until activity with the name, description, and a stopping expression that retries the dataflow until either the counter reaches 3 or the success variable matches Yes.
tasks.expectedOutcome: The Until activity is configured as Iterator and contains the completed expression `@or(equals(variables('varCounter'),3),equals(variables('varIsSuccess'), variables('varSuccess')))` in its Settings.

facts.fact: Set the Until activity name to Iterator.
facts.quote: 3. Enter **Name** as **Iterator**

facts.fact: Set the description to indicate retrying up to 3 times.
facts.quote: 4. Enter **Description** as “**Iterator to refresh dataflow. It will retry up to 3 times**”.

facts.fact: The stopping logic should execute until varCounter is 3 or varIsSuccess is Yes.
facts.quote: We need to write an expression which would execute until either the value of **varCounter is 3** or value **varIsSuccess is Yes**.

facts.fact: Use the logical or function in the expression builder.
facts.quote: 10. From the **Logical Functions** section, select **or** function. Notice **@or()** is added to the dynamic expression text box.

facts.fact: Build the first comparison as @or(equals(variables('varCounter'),3)).
facts.quote: 16. Enter **3** as the second parameter of the equals function. Like the screenshot below, your expression will be **@or(equals(variables('varCounter'),3))**

facts.fact: Use variables('varIsSuccess') as the first parameter of the second equals function.
facts.quote: 20. With the help of IntelliSense select **variables('varIsSuccess')**

facts.fact: Use variables('varSuccess') as the second parameter of the second equals function.
facts.quote: 22. With the help of IntelliSense select **variables('varSuccess')**. Here we are comparing the value of varIsSuccess to the value of varSuccess. (varSuccess is defaulted to Yes.)

facts.fact: The final expression should match the full or/equals formula shown in the task.
facts.quote: **@or(equals(variables('varCounter'),3),equals(variables('varIsSuccess'), variables('varSuccess')))**

tasks.title: Task 9: Configure 1<sup>st</sup> Set variable Activity
tasks.objective: Configure a Set variable activity that runs after a successful Dataflow activity to set the pipeline variable varIsSuccess to Yes so the Until iterator can exit.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A Set variable activity named set_varIsSuccess is connected to the success path of dfactivity_People_SharePoint Dataflow activity and sets pipeline variable varIsSuccess using the value of varSuccess.

facts.fact: The activity added is Set variable.
facts.quote: From the top menu, select **Activities -> Set variable**.

facts.fact: The Set variable activity name is set_varIsSuccess.
facts.quote: In the **Name** field, enter **set_varIsSuccess**

facts.fact: The description is Set variable varIsSuccess to Yes.
facts.quote: In the **Description** field, enter “**Set variable varIsSuccess to Yes”**.

facts.fact: The success connector used is the green check mark from dfactivity_People_SharePoint Dataflow activity to set_varIsSuccess.
facts.quote: Click the **green check mark** from dfactivity_People_SharePoint Dataflow activity and drag to connect to the new **set_varIsSuccess** **Set variable activity**.

facts.fact: Variable type must be Pipeline variable.
facts.quote: In the bottom pane, make sure **Variable type** is **Pipeline variable**.

facts.fact: The variable selected by name is varIsSuccess.
facts.quote: In the **Name** field, select **varIsSuccess**.

facts.fact: The value is populated using the variable expression @variables(‘varSuccess’).
facts.quote: Notice **@variables(‘varSuccess’)** is entered in the Add dynamic content below text area.

tasks.title: Task 10: Configure 2<sup>nd</sup> Set variable Activity
tasks.objective: Configure a second Set variable activity that runs on Dataflow failure and increments the pipeline variable varTempCounter using a dynamic expression.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A Set variable activity named set_varTempCounter is connected from the Dataflow activity’s failure path and is configured to set the pipeline variable varTempCounter to @add(variables('varCounter'),1).

facts.fact: Add a Set variable activity from the Activities menu.
facts.quote: From the top menu, select **Activities -> Set variable**.

facts.fact: Set the activity name to set_varTempCounter.
facts.quote: In the **Name** field, enter **set_varTempCounter**

facts.fact: Set the activity description to Increment variable varTempCounter.
facts.quote: In the **Description** field, enter “**Increment variable varTempCounter”**.

facts.fact: Connect the Dataflow activity failure path to the new Set variable activity.
facts.quote: Click the **red x-mark** from Dataflow activity to the new Set variable activity.

facts.fact: Configure Variable type as Pipeline variable.
facts.quote: In the bottom pane, make sure **Variable type** is **Pipeline variable**.

facts.fact: Select varTempCounter as the variable name.
facts.quote: In the **Name** field, select **varTempCounter**.

facts.fact: Enter the dynamic expression @add(variables('varCounter'),1) in the Value field.
facts.quote: Pipeline expression builder dialog opens. Enter **@add(variables('varCounter'),1)**

tasks.title: Task 12: Configure Wait Activity
tasks.objective: Configure a Wait activity in the pipeline to use a dynamic wait time based on varCounter and varWaitTime, then save the completed pipeline.
tasks.expectedOutcome: A Wait activity named wait_onFailure is connected after set_varCounter, uses the specified dynamic expression for wait time in seconds, and the pipeline is saved.

facts.fact: A Wait activity is added from Activities -> ellipsis (…) -> Wait.
facts.quote: From the top menu, select **Activities -> ellipsis (…) -> Wait**.

facts.fact: The Wait activity name is set to wait_onFailure.
facts.quote: In the **Name** field, enter **wait_onFailure**

facts.fact: The Wait activity description is set to “Wait for 300 seconds on 2nd try and 900 seconds on 3rd try”.
facts.quote: In the **Description** field, enter “**Wait for 300 seconds on 2nd try and 900 seconds on 3rd try”**.

facts.fact: The set_varCounter Set variable activity is connected to the wait_onFailure Wait activity.
facts.quote: Click the **green check mark** from set_varCounter Set variable activity and drag to connect to the new **wait_onFailure Wait activity**.

facts.fact: The Wait time in seconds field uses Add dynamic content.
facts.quote: In the **Wait time in seconds** field, select the **text box** and select **Add dynamic content** link.

facts.fact: The wait time expression entered is the provided nested if expression using varCounter and varWaitTime.
The pipeline is saved using Home -> Save icon.
facts.quote: From the top menu, select **Home -> Save icon** to save the pipeline.

tasks.expectedOutcome: The pipeline has a saved scheduled run configured to execute daily at 9 AM starting today, ending on a future date, in the selected time zone.

facts.fact: Open the schedule settings from the top menu.
facts.quote: From the top menu, select **Home -> Schedule**.

facts.fact: Add a new scheduled run.
facts.quote: Select the **+ Add Schedule** button below **Scheduled run**.

facts.fact: Set the repeat frequency to Daily.
facts.quote: Set **Repeat dropdown** to **Daily**.

facts.fact: Set the scheduled time to 9 AM.
facts.quote: Set **Time** to **9 AM**.

facts.fact: Set the start date and time to Today.
facts.quote: Set **Start date and time** to **Today**.

facts.fact: Set the end date and time to a future date.
facts.quote: Set **End date and time** to a **future date**.

facts.fact: Save the schedule configuration.
facts.quote: Select **Save**.
